a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two storm-free rounds before anyone takes, which is about a 4% chance for either of us. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than hiding it. If you also take, the split is random and we'll likely both fall short. After round 1, I commit to operating every round to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
